column1: # This is an operator contract, not a credential/config file. Values are
# source-derived proposals until Release/Infra and the owning plane approve
# them. A conformance run must remain blocked while status is `proposed`.
# A target of `unset` is allowed only while status is `proposed`: the value comes from
# the 7-day baseline of the running stack and is not asserted before it exists.
# Units: seconds, milliseconds, bytes, days, rows, per_mille. Operators: <=, ==, >=.

column7: Any decision lifetime above target blocks candidate promotion
Any issued-at future skew above target blocks effect execution
Missing or stale step decision blocks the scheduled step
A claim lease above target without HA evidence blocks delivery enablement
Callback outside the skew window is rejected and blocks acknowledgement
An unresolved sending/unknown outcome beyond target blocks retry and remains visible as unknown
